mapper.sql: select report_id, elder_id, elder_name, report_type, report_title, period_start, period_end, score, risk_level, summary, content, model_source, model_name, status, error_msg, archived_url, tenant_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from biz_health_report
mapper.select: select r.floor_no, r.room_no, b.bed_no from biz_bed b left join biz_room r on r.room_id = b.room_id where b.elder_id = #{elderId} and b.del_flag = '0' order by b.bed_id desc limit 1
select count(1) from biz_bill where elder_id = #{elderId} and pay_status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from biz_bill where elder_id = #{elderId} and pay_status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select coalesce(sum(paid_amount), 0) from biz_bill where elder_id = #{elderId} and pay_status = '1' and del_flag = '0'
